title: 第八章功法融合
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡把提纯好的丹药分出两份。

    一份成色极佳、表面甚至隐隐有流光转动的，被他贴身收好。

    这是留着自己突破用的底牌。

    另一份成色稍次、勉强算得上品相不错的，则被他随意装进一个灰布袋子里。

    他现在这副三十岁出头的模样实在太扎眼。

    要是顶着这张脸在宗门附近晃悠，被熟人撞见，那还解释得清吗？

    找了块黑布把脸蒙的严严实实，又换了身灰袍。要不是怕被熟人认出来，我才懒得穿这身破衣服。叶凡顺着后山那条小路，再次摸到了山脚下的黑市。

    黑市里依旧人声鼎沸，啥鸟都有。

    叶凡没去那些售卖高阶法器和灵草的摊位，而是专门往那些摆着破铜烂铁、杂书破卷的地摊凑。

    “老板，这本碎石拳怎么卖？”

    摊主是个老头，正靠在木椅上打盹，听见声音，极不情愿的掀开眼皮瞅了一眼。

    “一块下品灵石，爱买不买。”

    叶凡没接茬，直接从布袋里摸出两颗提纯过的锻体丹，扔在摊位那块破布上。

    我装作漫不经心的样子，其实心里早就乐开了花。

    老头眼睛猛的睁大，整个人都蒙圈了。浑身的瞌睡虫瞬间跑了个干净。

    他一把抓起丹药，放在鼻尖用力嗅了嗅。

    “好纯的药力啊！这成色，比百宝阁里卖的那些高档货还要好上几分呢！”

    老头态度立马变了，脸上堆满讨好的笑。

    “客官，您这丹药价值可不止一本碎石拳，您看摊上还有什么入眼的，随便挑！只要看上的，都给您包起来！”

    叶凡扫了一眼摊位上的破书。

    “再拿一本碎石拳，还有那本疾风腿法和飘叶步法。”

    老头愣住了，举着丹药的手停在半空。

    “您要两本干嘛？这碎石拳可是外门烂大街的入门货啊，连刚入门的杂役都不稀罕练！”

    “还有这腿法和步法，都是黄阶下品里的垫底货色，您拿这么好的丹药换这些，太亏了吧。”

    叶凡没搭理他，伸手把几本书卷起来，直接塞进怀里。

    旁边几个逛摊的散修凑过来看热闹。

    一个壮汉撇了撇嘴，指着叶凡的背影大声嚷嚷。

    “这年头真是什么怪人都有，拿这么好的丹药换一堆擦屁股都嫌硬的破烂。”

    “兄弟，你是不是有什么特殊癖好，专门收集这些垃圾啊？”

    “就是，有这丹药，去换本黄阶中品的武技不好吗？买一堆废纸回去供着？”

    叶凡连头都没回，压低头上的斗笠，转身挤进熙熙攘攘的人群，很快消失在黑市的巷子里。

    财不外露，更何况他现在急需验证心里的猜想，没空跟这帮人废话。

    回去的路上，叶凡脑子里一直在盘算。算了，不想了。不对，这事儿不弄明白我今天连觉都睡不好。

    合成炉的规则，他已经摸索出了一部分。

    三颗废丹，能合成一颗提纯的好丹。

    本质上，丹药还是那个丹药，锻体丹合出来依然是锻体丹，不会凭空变成凝气丹。

    品阶没有跨越，但效果发生了翻天覆地的变化。

    那功法呢？

    三本一模一样的碎石拳放进去，会合出一本什么东西？
content_en:
Ye Fan divided the purified elixir into two parts.

    A piece of excellent quality, with even a faint flow of light flowing on the surface, was put away by him.

    This is a trump card reserved for your own breakthrough.

    The other one, which was of slightly inferior quality and was barely in good condition, was randomly put into a gray cloth bag by him.

    His current appearance of being in his early thirties is really eye-catching.

    If he was wandering around the sect with this face on his face and was bumped into by an acquaintance, would he still be able to explain it clearly?

    He found a piece of black cloth to cover his face tightly, and changed into a gray robe. If it weren't for the fear of being recognized by acquaintances, I wouldn't bother wearing these shabby clothes. Ye Fan followed the path in the back mountain and once again touched the black market at the foot of the mountain.

    The black market is still bustling with people, and there are all kinds of birds.

    Ye Fan did not go to the stalls selling high-end magic weapons and spiritual herbs, but went to the stalls selling scraps of scrap metal and miscellaneous books and scrolls.

    "Boss, how do you sell this Stone Crushing Fist?"

    The stall owner was an old man, who was taking a nap while leaning on a wooden chair. When he heard the sound, he reluctantly opened his eyelids and took a look.

    "A low-grade spiritual stone, buy it if you like."

    Ye Fan didn't answer, just took out two purified body-building pills from the cloth bag and threw them on the rag in the stall.

    I pretended to be careless, but in fact I was already happy.

    The old man's eyes suddenly opened wide, and his whole body was blurred. All the sleepiness all over my body was gone in an instant.

    He grabbed the elixir, put it to the tip of his nose and sniffed it vigorously.

    "What a pure medicinal power! The quality is much better than those high-end products sold in Baibao Pavilion!"

    The old man's attitude immediately changed, with a flattering smile on his face.

    "Sir, your elixir is worth more than a Stone Fist. Take your pick of whatever else is on the stall! Whatever you like will be wrapped up for you!"

    Ye Fan glanced at the torn books on the stall.

    "Get another copy of Stone Fist, as well as the Wind Kick Technique and Floating Leaf Foot Technique."

    The old man was stunned, and the hand holding the elixir stopped in mid-air.

    "Why do you want two books? This gravel fist is an entry-level product for the outer sect. Even the handyman who has just started to practice it doesn't care about it!"

    "Also, these leg skills and footwork are the bottom of the Huang class. It would be a big loss for you to exchange such a good elixir for these."

    Ye Fan ignored him, reached out, rolled up a few books, and stuffed them directly into his arms.

    Several casual cultivators shopping nearby came over to watch the fun.

    A strong man curled his lips, pointed at Ye Fan's back and shouted loudly.

    "There are really all kinds of weirdos these days. They would exchange such a good elixir for a bunch of rags that are too hard to wipe your butt."

    "Brother, do you have any special hobby for collecting this kind of garbage?"

    "That's right, if you have this elixir, wouldn't it be better to exchange it for a middle-grade yellow-level martial skill? Buy a bunch of waste paper and go back to support it?"

    Ye Fan didn't even look back, lowered the bamboo hat on his head, turned around and squeezed into the bustling crowd, and quickly disappeared into the alley of the black market.

    The wealth should not be exposed, not to mention that he urgently needs to verify his suspicions now and has no time to talk nonsense with these people.

    On the way back, Ye Fan kept thinking in his mind. Forget it, don’t think about it anymore. No, I won’t even be able to sleep well today if I don’t understand this matter.

    He has already figured out part of the rules of the synthesis furnace.

    Three waste elixirs can be combined into one purified good elixir.

    In essence, the elixir is still the same elixir. The body-forging elixir is still a body-forging elixir when combined, and it will not turn into a Qi-condensing elixir out of thin air.

    The grade has not been crossed, but the effect has undergone earth-shaking changes.

    What about the exercises?

    If three identical volumes of gravel fists are put in, what will they produce?
